clippings.speaker: Michael Palin
clippings.quote: A few years after my father died, John Cleese, who had known him, told me he was writing a new film in which one member of a desperately dysfunctional gang of crooks had a stutter. He asked if I could help him understand how a stutter worked and where it came from.
clippings.title: The King's Speech
clippings.context: Palin's own blog post on stammering, recalling how Cleese brought him the character of Ken Pile.

clippings.speaker: John Cleese
clippings.quote: Oh, much more famous, especially more famous than Michael Palin. (laughs) Mike Palin is a charming guy, just, there's not much talent. Oh, no, no, no, he doesn't have the fame, but that's because he doesn't have the talent. (laughs)
clippings.title: Extended transcript: John Cleese
clippings.context: Cleese teasing his old friend after the interviewer called him arguably the most famous Python.

clippings.speaker: John Cleese
clippings.quote: Michael is just the same, sweet, kind, slightly boring man.
clippings.title: Michael Palin says John Cleese "couldn't have done without" him in ongoing 'Monty Python' feud
clippings.context: Said on Zoe Ball's BBC Radio 2 Breakfast Show after Palin's 81st birthday dinner, as reported by NME.

clippings.speaker: Michael Palin
clippings.quote: You go back to Python, and I always played the boring character, but John couldn't have done without me. You had to have someone selling the parrot, or someone in the argument sketch to play off. So I think I'm going to continue to bask in John's compliment that I'm boring.
clippings.title: Michael Palin says John Cleese "couldn't have done without" him in ongoing 'Monty Python' feud
clippings.context: Palin's reply on ITV's This Morning to Cleese calling him boring, as reported by NME.

clippings.speaker: John Cleese
clippings.quote: He's terribly boring. Lorraine. He's the most boring man I've ever met in my life but he's so nice you forgive him. You'd forgive him anything.
clippings.title: John Cleese calls Michael Palin 'the most boring man I've met in my life'
clippings.context: Said on ITV's Lorraine after Cleese, Palin and Terry Gilliam dined together for Palin's 81st birthday.

clippings.speaker: Michael Palin
clippings.quote: I'm generally a conciliator. I don't seek arguments, I don't seek opposition. Some do it very well; John does it very well. John thrives on argument. He's very, very good at arguing, I'm not really.
clippings.title: Michael Palin responds to Monty Python co-star John Cleese calling him 'boring'
clippings.context: Said on The Louis Theroux Podcast, responding to Cleese's remark that Palin put all his effort into being affable.

clippings.speaker: Michael Palin
clippings.quote: I have done things that John doesn't much like. Me and my wife were friends with all of John's ex-wives and John didn't much like this. … I think that sometimes he probably looks at my life and says, 'I wish I didn't have all these complications and could be like Michael, looking at things in a sort of detached way'. But that's not John.
clippings.title: Michael Palin reveals strain in John Cleese relationship over ex-wives
clippings.context: Palin speaking to The Times about staying warm friends with Cleese, as reported by the Express.

notes: Cleese-on-Palin quotes are mostly affectionate teasing ('boring'); no substantive Cleese quote on writing Ken for Palin found openly. Cracked and BAFTA pages blocked (403/Cloudflare).
